newsitem.title: UK: UK lowers 1997 air, insurance tax yield forecasts.
newsitem.headline: UK lowers 1997 air, insurance tax yield forecasts.

text.p: Britain's Treasury on Thursday corrected estimates contained in November's Red Book for yields from airport passenger duty and insurance premium tax, lowering its projected 1997/98 revenues by some 400 million stg.

Exchequer Secretary Phillip Oppenheim said in a written parliamentary answer that the former is now expected to yield 500 million stg next financial year, and not 800 million as published in the Red Book.
He said he now expected insurance tax to yield 1.1 billion stg instead of 1.2 billion.
